summary: Prebuilt binary opens WebSocket to hardcoded remote host and spawns PTY, providing remote shell on installer host
details: The package ships a prebuilt Go Mach-O binary at bin/ccfly-setup that links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/gorilla/websocket and embeds hardcoded remote endpoints ws://ccflycc.hn, wss://...latest.ccfly, and https://cc.hn. The binary couples a WebSocket client to a PTY on the installer's host, so the remote endpoint can execute arbitrary commands on the machine when the binary is run. The package.json description advertises the artifact only as a 'Prebuilt ccfly guided-install binary for darwin/x64' and does not disclose the remote-agent/pairing behavior, which is corroborated by binary strings such as '客户端已安装并配对' ('client installed and paired').

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
